uplink.description: Status report: relays 1&2 ON, relay 3 OFF; input0/input1 open, input2 closed
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r831d codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Relay_1 ON, Relay_2 ON, Relay_3 OFF, Input_1 OFF, Input_2 OFF, Input_3 ON. bytes 3/4/5 are relay outputs -> top-level extras (actuator state, not a measured position); byte6=0 -> input0 'open'; byte7=0 -> input1 'open'; byte8=1 -> input2 'closed'. The input positions DIFFER here, so a transposed entry is caught. No battery byte in this device's data frame. `analog-interface` resolves action.contactState through the entries.

uplink.description: Status report: input0 closed, input1 open, input2 closed; all relays OFF
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame with a distinct pattern per input terminal (closed / open / closed) and no relay energized, so per-position truth is exercised independently of the relay bytes. Upstream oracle semantics: Input_1 ON -> closed, Input_2 OFF -> open, Input_3 ON -> closed; Relay_1..3 all OFF.

uplink.description: Status report: all inputs closed, relay 3 ON only
uplink._note: All three terminals closed with only the third relay energized: covers the all-same input case and keeps the relay extras independent of the input entries. All three entries are emitted unconditionally (this format defines no disconnected-input sentinel).
